text:
maya: quick sync — follow-up from the adapter rfc: we need to decide fallthrough semantics between hosted/dedicated/private. do we allow silent model downgrade fallback by default?
kevin: +1 to discuss. silent fallback risky for SLO-critical tenants, should be opt-in per-tenant.
olga: agreed. security/audit wants explicit logging. private installs might reject any fallback.
runtime-bot: notice: canary-147 showed 3% latency regressions when forced onto heavier quantized variants.
maya: proposal: three policy modes: strict (no-fallback), tiered (authorized fallback + logged), permissive (auto-fallback). defaults: hosted=tiered, dedicated=strict, private=strict unless opt-in.
samir: question — how interacts w/ model pinning & rollouts? pinned releases must prevent fallback.
kevin: pinning should take precedence: pinned -> no downgrade. fallback only for unpinned refs like `redwood/fast-l2`.
olga: ops/visibility: on fallback emit control-plane event with fields tenant_id, original_model, fallback_model, reason, trace_id. prefer structured json logs.
maya: sample event payload (for audit):
```
{
  "tenant_id": "acct_123",
  "original": "rw-13b-v2",
  "fallback": "rw-13b-8bit",
  "trigger": "capacity_limit",
  "trace": "abcd-1234",
  "mode": "tiered"
}
```
samir: note: private deployments may have control-plane hooks disabled — need local-only audit sink option (file/syslog) for air-gapped installs.
kevin: add circuit-breaker: if fallback rate > 5% in 1m window for a tenant, disable auto-fallbacks and alert SRE. default thresholds overridable via enterprise contract.
maya: +1 to threshold. also need metric emitted: fallback_rate, fallback_count, last_fallback_ts.
olga: auth: only org admins can change fallback policy. record actor in audit events.
samir: ops: update rollout docs & console UI. propose per-env "Fallback policy" toggle and an event stream filter; console should show recent fallback events with links to traces.
maya: next: @kevin draft PR for control-plane event schema & circuit-breaker hooks; @samir draft private deploy audit sink; @olga write SRE runbook. target RFC follow-up by EOW.
kevin: will draft PR and post link.
deploy-bot: canary job queued: canary-fallback-guard — ETA 2h
maya: thanks all, capturing decisions in adapter rfc thread and marking action items.
olga: ack :thumbsup:
kevin: ack
samir: ack
